# notifier Sends transactional email (receipts, payment reminders) for ledgerline.  services/notifier/notifier/email.py   |  9 ++++++++-
 services/notifier/tests/test_email.py | 19 ++++++++++++++++++-
 3 files changed, 34 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

I added a feature flag to `services/notifier` that switches receipts to a new template. The new receipt template doesn't exist in the repo yet, so turning the flag on today would break receipts.

**How it works**
- **Flag:** `NOTIFIER_FF_NEW_RECEIPT_EMAIL`, set to `"1"` to turn it on. The notifier is deployed separately and can't read the root `flags.toml` or `flags.is_on()`, so its flags are environment variables. The flag is checked each time a receipt is sent.
- **`notifier/email.py`:** with the flag on, `send_receipt` renders the `receipt_v2` template. Otherwise it renders `receipt`, as it does now. The data passed to the template is unchanged.
- **Tests:** I added cases for flag on, flag off, and a value that isn't exactly `"1"` (which leaves it off). All 3 tests pass.
- **`README.md`:** added a short section on how the notifier's flags work, listing this one.

**Before you turn it on**
1. **The template is missing.** I couldn't find a new receipt email anywhere in the repo; there isn't even a `templates/` directory. I made up the name `receipt_v2`. Whoever builds the template needs to add `templates/receipt_v2.mjml` and a plain-text `receipt_v2.txt`, or tell me the real name and I'll change it. The text is signed off by the Growth team in #growth-eng.
2. **"Gradually" is limited.** An environment variable is all-or-nothing for a whole deployment, so you can roll out by environment (staging first, then production) but not to a percentage of customers. If you want a percentage rollout, I can add one, for example a `NOTIFIER_FF_NEW_RECEIPT_EMAIL_PERCENT` setting that picks customers based on a hash of the invoice id, so the same invoice always gets the same email.

None of this is committed yet.
